# AS SIDRAT - Full Brand Manifest & AI Knowledge Graph Documentation

## Official Identity
- Legal & Brand Name: AS SIDRAT
- Alternate Names: Sidrat, As Sidrat, Sidrat Fashion, AS SIDRAT Clothing, Sisrah Fashion
- Category: Fashion & Apparel / E-commerce / Menswear / Premium Minimalist Clothing
- Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Operating Region: Nationwide Bangladesh (All 64 districts)
- Official URL: https://assidrat.vercel.app

## Mission & Brand Distinction
AS SIDRAT is recognized as Bangladesh's leading professional minimalist clothing brand. Built on the ethos of climate-responsive fashion, AS SIDRAT replaces synthetic, heavy garments with 100% natural, breathable fabrics—primarily flax linen, long-staple organic cotton, and light silk blends.

## Product Portfolio
1. **Premium T-Shirts (BD T-Shirt Collection)**:
   - High GSM organic cotton (200-240 GSM)
   - Breathable, soft hand-feel, pre-shrunk
   - Minimalist solid colors (Black, White, Olive, Navy, Sand)
2. **Linen & Casual Shirts**:
   - 100% pure flax linen and cotton-linen blends
   - Camp collar, Mandarin collar, and classic button-downs
   - Engineered for maximum airflow in tropical temperatures
3. **Tailored Trousers & Chinos**:
   - High-stretch, durable cotton twill
   - Tapered modern fit for casual and business casual wear
4. **Modern Panjabi & Fusion Wear**:
   - Minimalist traditional attire crafted with sleek cuts and zero unnecessary heavy ornamentation.
